title: Your Home's $100K Gain Is Actually $54,500
hook: You're counting $100,000 in home equity — but after agents, closing costs, and repairs, your real check is $54,500. Nobody does this math before they sell.
angle: Everyone watches their Zillow estimate climb and treats paper equity like spendable money. But four guaranteed deductions — realtor commissions, seller closing costs, pre-sale repairs, and capital gains exposure — cut the average seller's equity by 40-50%. This video does the math nobody does.
audience: Homeowners watching their Zillow estimate climb and planning to sell in the next 2-5 years, treating paper equity as real wealth
key_numbers: 5-6% realtor commission = $23,100 on a $420K median-priced home
$14,000 average pre-sale repair and staging spend
$250K capital gains exclusion for single filers (15-20% above that)
$100K paper equity typically yields $45,000-$60,000 after all sale costs
